title: Trumai language
extract: Trumai is an endangered language isolate spoken by the Trumai people located in the Xingu reserve along the Upper Xingu River in central Brazil. Most Trumai are fluent in languages of wider communication, and children are not learning it well. It is highly divergent from other South American languages, such as distinguishing unusual consonants.
